summary: Completed comprehensive testing of SuperApp multi-service platform. Tested user authentication, admin dashboard, dispatcher panel, food ordering UI, wallet functionality, and support system. Found several backend API integration issues but core UI functionality is working well.

critical_bugs.issue: Admin endpoints returning 403 Insufficient permissions despite valid admin token
critical_bugs.impact: Admin dashboard stats and management features not working

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error during wallet top-up
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot add money to wallet

critical_bugs.issue: Order creation fails with 404 Merchant not found for demo merchants

authentication_issues.issue: JWT token authentication not working properly for admin role verification
authentication_issues.symptoms: Admin login succeeds but admin endpoints return 403
authentication_issues.workaround: Frontend admin panel loads but backend data fails

ui_bugs.issue: Restaurant cards not clickable on food page
User sessions expire quickly, requiring frequent re-login

integration_issues.issue: Cannot test complete cart and checkout flow due to restaurant card click issues

passed_tests: User home page loads with services grid (Ride, Moto, Food, Parcel)
Food page loads with restaurant listings
Wallet page loads correctly with balance display
Support page loads with FAQ and ticket form
Admin dashboard UI loads with stats cards
Dispatcher panel loads with live map
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix admin JWT token authentication issue causing 403 errors on admin endpoints. Fix wallet top-up 500 error. Ensure restaurant cards are clickable for food ordering flow. Address session management for better user experience.
